description: This file defines a FastAPI-based backend API for subtitle synchronization. It includes endpoints for uploading video and subtitle files, checking synchronization status, correcting subtitles, and downloading results. The code also sets up CORS middleware and uses Pydantic models for API responses.

classes.name: SyncCheckResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for responses from the subtitle sync check endpoint, indicating the offset, whether sync correction is needed, and human-readable details.

classes.name: SyncFixResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for responses from the subtitle sync fix endpoint, providing a URL for the corrected subtitle and details.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning a simple message indicating the backend is healthy.

methods.name: upload_files( video_file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Video file (e.g., mp4, mkv)"), subtitle_file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Subtitle file (.srt, .vtt supported)"), )
methods.description: API endpoint for uploading a video file and subtitle file; stores them temporarily and returns an upload session ID.

methods.name: check_sync( upload_id: str = Form(..., description="Returned ID from /api/upload"), )
methods.description: API endpoint to check the synchronization status of uploaded video and subtitle files, returning the offset and whether correction is necessary.

methods.name: fix_sync( upload_id: str = Form(..., description="Returned ID from /api/upload"), )
methods.description: API endpoint to automatically correct subtitle synchronization based on the uploaded files and return a download URL for the corrected subtitle.

methods.name: download_result(upload_id: str, filename: str)
methods.description: Serves the corrected subtitle file for download.
